card.name: Linking words in cardiac study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (then, in, of, a comma) and mid-word pieces such as attenu-ate, right before an expected cardiac effect or experimental result term. Seen in heart-related drug effect text, such as heart attack, tachycardia or hemodynamic studies.
